title: [YouPass Collect] - The number of inquiries received by the Tourist Information Office
prompt: The graph below shows the number of inquiries received by the Tourist Information Office in one city over a six-month period in 2011. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates the number of inquiries made to a Tourist Information Office through three different methods over a six-month period from January to June 2011.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while face-to-face and telephone inquiries showed an upward trend during the period shown, communication by email or letter declined steadily. In addition, in-person visits experienced the most dramatic change, rising from the lowest to the highest position.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding methods with increasing trends, in January, telephone inquiries recorded the highest figure at approximately 800, while in-person visits were much lower at around 400. The latter then rose dramatically, climbing to roughly 750 by March and continuing upward to reach nearly 1200 inquiries in June. Meanwhile, telephone communication showed a more modest increase after remaining stable until March, ending the period at about 1000 inquiries.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for email and letter communication, this method started with approximately 600 inquiries in January, higher than face-to-face visits but lower than phone calls. However, the numbers decreased consistently throughout the six months, dropping to around 450 by April and falling further to just 200 inquiries in the final month.
